Lishchyn Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zhytomyr Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This is the older of at least two documented Jewish cemeteries in Lishchyn, and local memory of it is unusually faint: even the elderly residents who helped identify its location have never personally seen the site, and none could say when or by whom it was demolished — likely during WWII or earlier. That same informant, a 70-year-old local woman, also mentioned a third Jewish cemetery in Lishchyn, 'on the hill near the pine trees,' though no further details could be obtained and it is not otherwise documented in this collection.
